title: Bias Beware: The Impact of Cognitive Biases on LLM-Driven Product Recommendations

bias_targets.methodology: Adversarially modifying product descriptions to embed cognitive biases (e.g., social proof, scarcity, exclusivity, discount framing, authority bias, decoy effect) using human-crafted sentences or LLM-generated rewrites, and measuring the resulting changes in recommendation rate and ranking position.
